senses.gloss: (b. h.; נָחַת)under, beneath, in place of, instead of.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Peah 7:3">Peah VII, 3</cite> <he>המניח … ת׳ הגפן וכ׳</he> he who places a basket under a vine when cutting grapes, robs the poor.
<cite ref="Tosefta Demai 6:4">Tosef. Dem. VI, 4</cite> <he>תַּחְתַּיי</he> in my place, v. <cite ref="A00825"><he>אוֹצָר</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 18">Gen. R. s. 18</cite> <he>מת׳ חרוב אחד</he> from under a carob tree; a. v. fr.
